findings.perspective_scene_history: Low patio view, tea mug and bin frame the empty captured plastic bag. Bag is on the ground, separate from mouths, matching the presentation state. Only a cropped human shoe/hem is shown; likeness remains provisional. Contemporary domestic setting matches the story.
findings.action_comedy_continuity: Neet looks expectantly toward the human while Buddy lowers his nose to the unrewarding bag. The proud appeal versus ordinary rubbish is readable. No rank number, restored star or invented victory is shown.
